latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of "viral-content-expert" skill targeting secondary creation ("二创") for viral content across Douyin, WeChat Channels, and Xiaohongshu.

- Supports end-to-end workflow for secondary content creation: from hotspot tracking, material collection, script/copywriting, platform adaptation to delivery.
- Strictly focuses on 二创 output (≥85%) based on user input, platform logic, and compliance standards.
- Provides dedicated templates and requirements per platform (Douyin, Channels, Xiaohongshu) including UC-style headlines, interactive wording, and tag curation.
- Integrated hotspot mining, platform trend search, copywriting optimization, PRD/visual design, and fact-checking—only as they serve 二创.
- Clear interaction, file delivery, and update/iteration rules ensuring efficient, ready-to-publish viral content.
- Adheres to strict compliance and quality control: no sensationalism, misinformation, or off-topic content.
